root_cause: AI model, residency and connector changes generated a shared impact portfolio and were visible in the sovereignty panel, but the canonical CSRD & Impact page still drew only its resource snapshot and did not surface the review.
prevention: Consume the same authenticated tenant sovereignty readback; never use admin or global scope for customer CSRD dashboards.
Project pending CSRD/ESRS scope and materiality reviews into the existing CSRD page without implying a legal obligation, measured emissions, or finished audit.
Keep asynchronous readbacks bound to the active page and latest request revision to avoid stale cross-navigation results.
Keep user-controlled data out of HTML and test ESRS labels against an allowlist.

evidence.outcome: Customer CSRD dashboard shows pending evidence review from the tenant's canonical AI/sovereignty policy; actual customer auth readback requires live authorized user session.
